summary: A press release is a short, journalist-facing news document with a single goal: make it so easy to publish your news that a busy reporter (or a wire-service automated feed) can run it nearly verbatim.

facts.text: A press release is a short, journalist-facing news document with a single goal: make it so easy to publish your news that a busy reporter (or a wire-service automated feed) can run it nearly verbatim.
The defining traits of a press release:
Third person, past or present tense, never "we"
Inverted-pyramid structure
AP Style dateline at the top of the body
Stable boilerplate at the bottom (the "About" paragraph)
Quote attribution that is publication-ready
End mark: ### centered on its own line
400–600 words is the sweet spot
Under ~100 characters.
No marketing puffery: avoid "industry-leading," "revolutionary," "best-in-class."
State the news, not the spin.
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE - the default
EMBARGOED UNTIL: [Day, Month Day, Year, HH:MM TIME ZONE]
MEDIA ADVISORY - for an upcoming event/availability
Always include the time zone for embargoes.
City name in ALL CAPS
AP state abbreviation (not USPS!)
Date written out: Nov. 12, 2026 (AP uses abbreviated months for Jan., Feb., Aug., Sept., Oct., Nov., Dec.)
Em dash (—) before the lede
The first sentence must contain Who, What, When, Where, Why.
Bad lede: > Acme Corp, a leading provider of analytics solutions, is excited to announce today an important new milestone in its ongoing growth journey.
Good lede: > Acme Corp today announced it has acquired Beta Analytics, a Boston-based real-time data platform, for $400 million in cash and stock.
Paragraph 2: amplification - the size, the scope, the differentiator.
Paragraph 3: the executive quote.
Paragraph 4–5: supporting detail.
Paragraph 6: optional second quote.
Paragraph 7: practical info - availability, pricing, link.
Boilerplate: stable "About" paragraph(s).
Media contact block.
Standard pattern: > "We chose Beta because their real-time architecture is the strongest in the market," said Jane Doe, CEO of Acme Corp.
Attribution after the first sentence of the quote.
said is the AP-standard verb. Avoid stated, commented, noted, exclaimed.
Full name + title + company on first reference.
60–120 words. Updated when a hard fact changes.
The release ends with ### centered on its own line (or the older -30-).
How to Write an AP Style Press Release - PR Newswire
AP Stylebook
Announcing a funding round, acquisition, product launch, or executive hire in a format a wire service or reporter can run nearly verbatim.

facts.text: A press release's success depends on wire pickup and journalist judgment, not just correct formatting — a technically perfect release can still go unpublished if the news itself isn't newsworthy.

facts.text: Embargo dates depend on every recipient honoring them; a release marked "EMBARGOED UNTIL" has no technical enforcement mechanism, only the norm that reporters and wire services respect it.
